name: popsicle
headline: shortfactory: Claude Code skill for marketing
short_description: Your AI-powered content factory for automated short-form videos. Transform ideas into engaging social media content with advanced style transfer, smart asset management, and multi-platform optimization. Built on ShortGPT's foundation with enhanced features for the modern content creator.
author: realwarpie

sections.overview:
Shortfactory is an AI-powered content factory that automates the creation of short-form videos for social media platforms. It leverages advanced style transfer and smart asset management to transform ideas into engaging content efficiently. The skill is built on ShortGPT's foundation and includes multi-platform optimization features designed for modern content creators who need to produce videos at scale.
Rapidly generate multiple short-form videos from a single content idea
Apply consistent visual styles across video assets using style transfer
Optimize and distribute videos across multiple social media platforms simultaneously
Automate asset management for video production workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/realwarpie/shortfactory`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 30-second short-form video for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The video should promote [PRODUCT/SERVICE] using [STYLE] (e.g., cinematic, playful, minimalist). Include [KEY MESSAGE] and optimize for [PLATFORM] (e.g., Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts). Use [DATA] (e.g., customer testimonials, product features) to make the content engaging.
```
